risks: Published RS-BASE-01 has RS-DRV-01 foundation dependency absent from LSX-WP-018 explicit edges; an empty external_prerequisites array is not proof of readiness.

Server registration, Task CAS/persistence/event support, parent routing and locale writes are not among this worker's normative paths. A client-only function or UI callback cannot legitimately satisfy authenticated durable authority; missing seams need reviewed lead scope expansion, not adapter simulation.

Task status is timestamp-derived, not a writable universal enum: cancel leaves completedAt, reopen leaves trashedAt, and completeTask may create a recurring successor. Incorrect precedence/command choice can silently diverge from native Tasks.
The existing Notes projection rows represent Note identities and Markdown task counts, not native Tasks. Copying those into Board or storing Board-local status violates one canonical entity.
Lane counts from pagination/render windows leak or miscount; use the exact common authorized query aggregate and invalidate on permission epoch change.
Restoring the drag-origin snapshot on conflict/revoke can reveal revoked data or regress newer canonical state; restoration must use current authorized readback.
No-group setup wording is compressed in the package summary; normative design explicitly requires setup. Do not weaken it to an empty Board.
Preflight source generations can change under root-owned wave0 integration; NotesViewHost already differs from published baseline. Hash validation is not integrated revision or runtime acceptance.
Provider/collaboration evidence is required when exercised; no such effects were invoked here. All full DoD and proof lanes remain NOT_VERIFIED.
